FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Elegant Timepieces & Jewelry specializes in the retail of fine jewelry and luxury watches, providing a curated selection of ethically sourced gemstones and precious metals. Our operations focus on delivering exceptional customer service in a secure retail environment, conducting minor repairs such as ring resizing and battery replacements on the premises. We have implemented robust inventory management and loss prevention protocols to ensure the security of our high-value items. Our store is equipped with a 24/7 monitored alarm and surveillance system, providing enhanced protection against theft. With a commitment to maintaining a safe environment, we do not engage in any on-site manufacturing processes or food preparation, thereby reducing potential hazards. We prioritize the trust of our customers by conducting thorough background checks for all employees who handle inventory, ensuring a secure shopping experience.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in on-site cooking or food preparation, and confirms that our annual gross sales do not exceed $1,000,000. Additionally, we do not operate as a pawn shop or primary consignment business, nor do we conduct any on-site manufacturing that involves hazardous chemicals or casting.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2023, a theft incident occurred at our jewelry store where two luxury watches valued at $2,500 were stolen. The case has been reported to the police and is currently under investigation.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Secured high-grade safe, Class B, UL listed for fire protection and theft resistance.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: 24/7 monitored alarm system with additional motion sensors and on-site security personnel during business hours.
